sentences.en: In a tweet, the president wrote, quote,
sentences.zh: 总统在推特上写道，引述：

sentences.en: If Turkey does anything that I, in my great and unmatched wisdom, consider to be off-limits, I will totally destroy and obliterate the economy of Turkey.
sentences.zh: “如果土耳其做出任何我以其伟大和无与伦比的智慧认为是不允许的事情，我将彻底摧毁并消灭土耳其的经济。”

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: In their latest demand for documents, the leaders of the
sentences.zh: 在其最新的文件索取要求中，

sentences.en: House impeachment inquiry subpoenaed the Defense Department and the Office of Management and
sentences.zh: 众议院弹劾调查的领导人向国防部和管理及预算

sentences.en: Budget for documents about why the White House withheld nearly $400 million in security aid to
sentences.zh: 办公室发出传票，要求提供关于白宫为何扣留近4亿美元对乌克兰

sentences.en: Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 安全援助的文件的。

sentences.en: Both a whistleblower complaint and text messages from senior U.S.
sentences.zh: 无论是举报人的投诉还是美国高级外交官的

sentences.en: diplomats have raised the possibility that Trump withheld the money in order to pressure Ukraine to carry out political favors,
sentences.zh: 短信都提出了这样一种可能性，即特朗普扣留这笔资金是为了施压乌克兰开展政治恩惠，

sentences.en: including an investigation into Joe Biden and his son.
sentences.zh: 包括对乔·拜登及其儿子的调查。

sentences.en: And on Monday, a federal judge rejected
sentences.zh: 而在周一，一名联邦法官拒绝了

sentences.en: President Trump's effort to shield his tax returns from New York prosecutors, calling the president's
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统试图保护其纳税申报表免受纽约检察官调查的努力，称总统

sentences.en: argument that he is immune from such investigations, quote, repugnant to the nation's governmental structure and constitutional values.
sentences.zh: 关于他免受此类调查豁免的论点，引述：“是对国家政府结构和宪法价值观的厌恶。”

sentences.en: The New York prosecutors had subpoenaed eight years of Trump's tax returns over the summer.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，纽约检察官传唤了特朗普八年的纳税申报表。

sentences.en: As part of an investigation into hush money, the president paid to women who said they had affairs with him, prompting a lawsuit from Trump to block the subpoena.
sentences.zh: 作为对总统向声称与他有染的女性支付封口费的调查的一部分，这引发了特朗普阻止该传票的诉讼。

sentences.en: Lawyers for the president immediately appealed Monday's ruling, which could eventually require him to hand over the returns.
sentences.zh: 总统的律师立即对周一的裁决提出了上诉，这最终可能要求他交出纳税申报表。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日简报》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bobarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎进了一群自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》的最新一期节目中，由我萨拉·科尼格为您讲述人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 《都市》。
